notes:
PDF to Word keeps a table's shape now.

Columns are found the way the page draws them, so a column of labels is no longer swallowed into the figures beside it, and dates stay left while amounts line up on the right. The sheet size and margins come from the original rather than defaulting to Letter, pictures appear where they were drawn, and Arabic reads correctly inside table cells.

If an update is ever refused, the message now tells you how to recover instead of telling you not to.
